svg.title: DC lead selection and three-dimensional routing
svg.desc: Orthographic XY and XZ projections of the red RAW9 and black return centrelines. R10 is the true three-dimensional minimum bend, not a radius measured on either projection. X67.475 is the nominal mated housing rear plane from the Molex 23.50 mm reference; it is not a tolerance guarantee.
svg.text: DC lead selection and three-dimensional routing
LAPP H05V-K 0.50 mm² · maximum OD 2.50 mm · fixed-installation bends ≥R10 mm
+Y points toward the rear; see the side view for separation in Z.
+Z upward; the service loops rise before approaching J302.
but differ by 4.20 mm in Z.
Not a radius measured in projection.
C · Selected parts and local assembly conditions
Form separately; do not twist tight
J61 mate: Molex 39-01-2025 + two 39-00-0039 contacts; use the 0.50 mm² crimp process.
* X67.475 is the nominal housing rear plane from the 23.50 mm maker REF dimension.
REF dimensions are not tolerance guarantees; actual crimp and insulation exit are not dimensioned.
Route shown: two tilted service loops and two local insulating sleeves. No bonded DC jacket block.
Endpoint locations identify the console termination bay, not unmeasured Switchcraft solder-lug coordinates.
These are orthographic centreline projections. Nearby-body projections do not imply a three-dimensional collision.
Check the fitted mate, relaxed terminals, final wire dressing and physical continuity before applying power.
